title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $\rho$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. translated_title: 子空间方向何时对LoRA重要？少样本自适应中幅值原则的情境分析
translated_abstract: 我们证明LoRA适配器的初始输入子空间方向的重要性是依赖于情境的，并通过理论与实验刻画了这种依赖关系。这一结论修正了近期认为谱初始化仅通过更新幅值起作用的观点。当有标签数据相对于表示维度较为稀缺，且用于初始化的激活子空间能够捕捉有监督任务结构时，方向的影响最为显著。在这一情境下，适配器的行空间对其初始点保持敏感，使得任务对齐的初始化尤为有用。基于尖峰协方差的扰动分析刻画了所估计子空间的有限样本稳定性。对LoRA训练第一步的分析解释了子空间与任务对齐为何重要，并由此引出一个对齐系数ρ，该系数能够紧密追踪各分类任务上的性能提升。我们通过PivotLoRA验证了这一解释，该方法从……初始化适配器（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明LoRA初始子空间方向的重要性取决于情境：在少样本且初始化子空间能捕捉任务结构时方向对齐至关重要，并提出对齐系数ρ来预测增益、以及PivotLoRA进行任务对齐初始化。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the importance of LoRA's initial subspace direction is regime-dependent—most critical when labeled data are scarce and the initialization subspace captures task structure—and introduces an alignment coefficient ρ that predicts gains and PivotLoRA for task-aligned initialization.
